result.title: Detector Operating Behavior Inference via Data-Space Sampling
result.summary: A detector scores candidate detections, but the recall and false alarms at a given confidence threshold depend on the input distribution. We introduce Detector Operating Behavior Inference (DOBI), a second-level inference task: estimating a fixed detector's threshold-dependent, distribution-level operating response from the internal evidence of a single unlabeled image. DOBI treats the detector's threshold response, i.e. recall, false positives, and precision across thresholds, as a latent behavioral state under the current data condition. Controlled data-space sampling probes this state space offline, and a lightweight monitor learns the inverse map from one image to this state, whose single functional output supports multiple operating policies. In a controlled proof of concept with a fixed YOLOv10-Nano person detector and COCO-derived degradations, predicted PR behavior reduces mean absolute deviation from 0.128 for an image-independent mean-behavior prior to 0.054, and predicted functional distances track empirical regime distances (Spearman 0.96). From one unlabeled image, the inferred behavior selects operating points as well as a non-deployable lookup that knows the true regime (macro-regime $F_1$ 0.6604 for both, versus 0.6407 under pristine calibration; oracle 0.6620). On this discrete benchmark, regime-supervised curve lookups are strong controls. Pre-specified continuous and compositional probing shows where functional inference matters: on unseen combinations, the functional decoder has a lower mean curve error than a template lookup, increasingly with distance from the training conditions, whereas the lookup is more accurate for interpolation. These results establish the feasibility of single-image inference of distribution-level detector behavior over the probed conditions. Source code is available at https://github.com/beckerio/dobi

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DOBI 任务：把固定检测器在不同置信阈值下的召回、误检与精度曲线视为一个依赖输入分布的潜在行为状态，通过受控数据空间采样离线探测该状态空间，并训练轻量 monitor 从单张无标注图像反推该状态，再用其功能输出支持多种工作点策略。在 YOLOv10-Nano 与 COCO 退化数据上，预测 PR 行为的平均绝对偏差由 0.128 降至 0.054。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文「由单次观测推断自身分布级行为/可靠性状态并据此选择工作点」可能为 LVR 中基于当前证据估计可信度以决定继续推理、验证或停止（STOP）提供类比线索；但其属检测器校准工程，未涉及多模态推理状态或 latent 推理生成，迁移价值需核查。
